paras: The factory turbo inlet pipe, located between the compressor housing and the intake hose, is designed to direct air into the turbocharger. However, in doing so, it prioritizes reduced engine bay noise over performance, relying on low-cost molded plastic rather than durable materials. Over time, this plastic component is prone to warping or cracking from the heat and pressure cycles under the hood.

The LEYO Aluminum Turbo Inlet Pipe for the MK8 R and 8Y S3 offers a superior solution—replacing the factory part with a robust, straight-through aluminum design that enhances airflow and durability while eliminating the weaknesses of the stock setup.
hl: CNC Aluminum OEM neck for secure fitment.
Equipped with a sealing O-ring to ensure a perfect fit and seal with the compressor housing.
ft: Turbo Inlet Pipe for Golf MK8 R/T-Roc R/Tiguan-R & Audi 8Y S3 & Cupra Leon VZx Cupra Formentor VZx
